protocol.name: xd_test_input_v1

description.summary: testing only: touchscreens, drawing tablets and touchpad gestures

protocol.description:
The UI tests run the compositor on wlroots' headless backend, which has no input devices, and the virtual pointer and keyboard protocols have no touch, pens or gestures. With this global (offered only when the compositor runs with --allow-virtual-input) a client gets one device of each kind, made by the compositor as a real wlroots device and handled as one from libinput would be: a touchscreen, a drawing tablet with a pen and a pad, and a touchpad that makes gestures. They appear on the first request that uses them and go when this object is destroyed.
Coordinates are layout coordinates (the logical desktop); the compositor converts them for the area the device is mapped to, as a real device reports them.

description.summary: a finger touches the screen (then a frame)
the touchscreen cancels a touch (then a frame)
the pen comes near the tablet (in nonzero) or leaves it
the pen moves; pressure 0 to 1, tilt in degrees
the pen's tip touches the tablet (down nonzero) or lifts
a button on the pen (an evdev code, BTN_STYLUS...)
a button on the tablet's pad (counted from 0)
a finger on the pad's ring, at an angle in degrees
a finger on the pad's strip, 0 to 1
scale against the start, rotation in degrees since the last

request.name: unplug_output
request.description: The output of that name (HEADLESS-2...) is destroyed, as a monitor unplugged is, while the session runs. Unknown names are ignored.
